notes: Version 2.5 corrects the attribution of recursive non-injectivity, the hypotheses of the metric extraction and a notation collision. ENI Corollary 6 proves non-injectivity at every stratum of a tower of projections under its own premises on each projection (surjectivity, observables defined by the projection, a level not isomorphic to the one below); these premises are not consequences of the axioms A1-A4, and their verification for the strata proposed by the programme is open, as it is for the local transition map of A2. The introduction, the axiom section, the comparison with the Page-Wootters model and Table 1 state the ENI result with its premises. The identification of the effective metric from the principal symbol of the limit operator (Q5b) is conditional on the spatial limit hypothesis [H-L] and on the open lifting hypothesis [H-lift], and the Lorentzian signature also on the hyperbolicity hypothesis of the Born-Infeld paper; the stale Q5b version label is removed. The Weil module of the supplied Heisenberg-Schrödinger carrier is now written W, with V_c its blocks; V_rho denotes only the spinor carrier C^2 supplied conditionally by O23. The notation identifies neither W nor V_c with the admissible fibre, the Heisenberg-Schrödinger carrier or the spinor carrier. Table 1 and three displayed equations are reset within the page. No Foundation theorem is changed.
